items.title: 華爾街瘋預測市場！Polymarket身價不到一年翻倍 拚破200億美元
items.title_en: Wall Street Goes Crazy on Prediction Markets! Polymarket Doubles Its Valuation in Less Than a Year, Aiming for $20 Billion
paras: 預測市場平台 Polymarket 正尋求以超過 200 億美元估值募資約 10 億美元，目前已與潛在投資人展開初步洽談。若順利完成交易，其估值將較 2025 年 10 月的 90 億美元翻逾一倍，凸顯預測市場產業快速成長，投資人對這類可押注選舉、體育及其他真實事件的平台興趣持續升溫。
根據外媒周二 (4 日) 報導，有知情人士透露，Polymarket 今年 4 月才完成另一輪募資，當時估值為 150 億美元，並引進避險基金 D.E. Shaw 與創投公司 G Squared 成為新投資人。既有股東 SV Angel、Dragonfly 及 Valor Equity Partners 也參與增資，加上洲際交易所 (ICE) 投入的 6 億美元，該輪募資總額約 10 億美元。
Polymarket 拒絕評論最新募資計畫，D.E. Shaw 及 G Squared 也未回覆詢問。總部位於紐約的 D.E. Shaw 管理資產超過 1000 億美元，是最早投入演算法交易的大型投資機構之一。由 Steve Cohen 領導的 Point72 Asset Management 旗下創投部門，也曾投資 Polymarket。

年營收突破 12 億美元 估值數月三級跳

Polymarket 由執行長 Shayne Coplan 領導，讓使用者針對現實世界事件結果下注，並透過大型交易公司提升平台流動性。自 4 月募資後，Polymarket 已在美國開放平台，年化營收增加兩倍至超過 12 億美元。
6 月及 7 月舉行的世界盃也刺激預測市場交易量攀升。從 2025 年 10 月估值 90 億美元、今年 4 月升至 150 億美元，再到最新一輪尋求突破 200 億美元，Polymarket 估值不到一年便出現三級跳。
不過，其最大競爭對手 Kalshi 同樣快速擴張。Kalshi 今年 5 月宣布完成新一輪募資，估值達 220 億美元，已高於 Polymarket 目前追求的水準。受到 Polymarket 營運及法律問題影響，Kalshi 今年以來的成長速度也明顯領先。根據 Dune Analytics 使用者彙整的數據，Kalshi 上月交易量達 Polymarket 的 3 倍。

交易量遭 Kalshi 超車 監管調查成募資隱憂

除了競爭壓力，Polymarket 還因社群媒體行銷活動遭美國商品期貨交易委員會 (CFTC) 調查。此前有報導指控該公司推動不實行銷內容。Polymarket 先前表示，已針對目前使用的宣傳內容展開稽核，以確保符合公司標準及相關監管與法律揭露要求。
為支撐美國業務擴張，Polymarket 近月陸續延攬多名資深主管。曾在叫車平台 Lyft 擔任營運主管、後來負責 Uber 國際成長業務的 Travis VanderZanden，已從邁阿密搬至紐約，出任 Polymarket 成長長並負責行銷業務。
Polymarket 也延攬曾協助領導紐約證券交易所交易技術平台 Pillar 的工程師 Hayk Mkrtchyan，負責開發其美國交易所。前政府效率部 (DOGE) 成員 Jonathan Mendelson 則已於去年加入，擔任高階策略主管。
年化營收快速成長與華爾街資金進場，為 Polymarket 尋求逾 200 億美元估值提供支撐；但 Kalshi 交易量大幅領先，加上監管調查尚未落幕，仍可能影響投資人對這輪募資及其估值合理性的判斷。
paras_en: Prediction‑market platform Polymarket is seeking to raise about $1 billion at a valuation of more than $20 billion, and has already begun preliminary talks with potential investors. If the deal closes, its valuation would be more than double the $9 billion it had in October 2025, underscoring the rapid growth of the prediction‑market industry and the rising interest from investors in platforms that let users bet on elections, sports and other real‑world events.

According to foreign media reports on Tuesday (the 4th), a source familiar with the matter said Polymarket only completed another financing round in April this year, at which time it was valued at $15 billion and brought in hedge fund D.E. Shaw and venture‑capital firm G Squared as new investors. Existing shareholders SV Angel, Dragonfly and Valor Equity Partners also participated in the capital increase, and with Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) contributing $600 million, the round raised roughly $1 billion in total.

Polymarket declined to comment on the latest fundraising plan, and D.E. Shaw and G Squared did not respond to inquiries. New‑York‑based D.E. Shaw manages over $100 billion in assets and is one of the earliest large institutions to invest in algorithmic trading. The venture arm of Point72 Asset Management, led by Steve Cohen, has also invested in Polymarket.
Annual revenue tops $1.2 billion, valuation jumps three tiers in months

Polymarket, led by CEO Shayne Coplan, lets users place bets on the outcomes of real‑world events and uses large trading firms to boost platform liquidity. Since the April financing, Polymarket has opened its platform in the United States, and annualized revenue has tripled to over $1.2 billion.

The World Cup in June and July also spurred a surge in prediction‑market trading volume. Valuation rose from $9 billion in October 2025 to $15 billion in April, and now the latest round is targeting over $20 billion, marking a three‑step jump in less than a year.

However, its biggest rival Kalshi is expanding just as quickly. Kalshi announced a new financing round in May, valuing it at $22 billion, already above Polymarket’s current target. Affected by Polymarket’s operational and legal issues, Kalshi’s growth this year has clearly outpaced its competitor. According to data compiled by Dune Analytics users, Kalshi’s trading volume last month was three times that of Polymarket.
Trading volume overtaken by Kalshi and regulatory probe raise fundraising concerns

In addition to competitive pressure, Polymarket is under investigation by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) for its social‑media marketing activities. Earlier reports accused the company of promoting false marketing content. Polymarket previously said it has audited its current promotional materials to ensure they meet company standards and relevant regulatory and legal disclosure requirements.

To support its U.S. expansion, Polymarket has recently hired several senior executives. Travis VanderZanden, who was operations head at ride‑hailing platform Lyft and later led Uber’s international growth, moved from Miami to New York to become Polymarket’s chief growth officer, overseeing marketing and business development.

Polymarket also hired Hayk Mkrtchyan, an engineer who helped build the New York Stock Exchange’s trading‑technology platform Pillar, to develop its U.S. exchange. Former Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) member Jonathan Mendelson joined last year as senior strategy officer.

Rapid revenue growth and Wall Street capital backing support Polymarket’s push for a valuation above $20 billion; however, Kalshi’s far‑ahead trading volume and an ongoing regulatory probe could still affect investors’ assessment of this round and the reasonableness of its valuation.

items.title: 川普擬對多晶矽設底價、加關稅！太陽能板與晶片恐變貴
items.title_en: Trump Administration to Impose Floor Price and Tariffs on Polysilicon Imports, Raising Costs for Solar Panels and Chips
paras: 川普政府準備對進口多晶矽及相關產品設定最低價格並加徵關稅，將這項太陽能板與半導體的關鍵原料，納入美國抗衡中國人工智慧 (AI) 與能源產業的重要戰略。相關決定預計本月稍晚公布。
《路透》周二 (4 日) 援引四名知情人士消息報導，川普政府考慮採取混合制度，結合最低進口價格與關稅，保護 Hemlock Semiconductor 及德國瓦克化學 (Wacker Chemie) 在美國經營的多晶矽工廠，並遏制中國在晶片供應鏈持續擴張的影響力。
其中兩名人士表示，計畫可能允許投資美國矽晶圓及太陽能電池產能的進口商，抵銷部分貿易保護措施帶來的成本。目前中國約占全球太陽能製造產能的 80%，美國希望透過相關政策，將更多供應鏈環節移回國內。

多晶矽牽動太陽能與晶片兩大產業

多晶矽是純度極高的矽材料，位於半導體與太陽能製造供應鏈最上游。製造商先將多晶矽加工成矽晶圓，再製成太陽能電池並組裝為太陽能板；半導體製造同樣需要高純度多晶矽。
半導體產業協會 (SIA) 數據顯示，晶片業僅占全球多晶矽需求約 2.4%。然而，太陽能產業龐大的使用量，可協助多晶矽生產商維持規模及產能，間接支撐晶片所需原料的供應。
在休士頓附近經營太陽能板工廠的日本 Toyo 策略長 Rhone Resch 表示，川普政府正發現，美國發展本土半導體製造「其實真的需要太陽能」。Toyo 並計畫投資 3.57 億美元，在附近興建太陽能電池廠。
美國商務部針對多晶矽進口是否威脅國家安全進行長達一年的調查，川普預計將依《貿易擴張法》第 232 條採取行動。該條款授權總統限制被認定威脅國安的進口商品，川普此前已利用這項權力對鋼鐵、汽車及半導體等產品加徵關稅。
中國駐美大使館批評相關調查，敦促美國盡快停止第 232 條關稅措施，並透過平等對話處理各方疑慮。白宮表示不會在川普作出決定前評論，商務部則未回覆詢問。

保護本土產能恐推高能源與科技成本

美國國會 2022 年推出稅務優惠後，國內太陽能製造業快速擴張，但多數投資集中在最後階段的面板組裝，矽晶圓及太陽能電池仍高度依賴進口，因為上游工廠需要更長的投資及建設時間。
Toyo、Qcells、康寧 (GLW-US)、阿特斯陽光電力(Canadian Solar)(CSIQ-US) 及 T1 Energy(TE-US)等業者，已宣布或開始投資供應鏈上游產能，以符合聯邦清潔能源補貼的美國製造要求。
不過，美國太陽能製造商協會及跨黨派國會議員警告，在美國多晶矽、矽晶圓與太陽能電池產能足以供應市場前，仍需要南韓 OCI Holdings，以及在馬來西亞和德國設廠的瓦克化學等非中國供應商。
Hemlock 在密西根州設有工廠，是康寧與日本信越半導體的合資企業；瓦克化學則在田納西州營運生產基地。瓦克強調，沒有多晶矽，就不可能發展後續的矽晶圓、晶片及太陽能電池產業。
川普政府必須在扶植本土生產與控制成本之間取得平衡。資料中心建設熱潮正推升晶片及電力需求，太陽能開發商與半導體買方警告，關稅可能提高太陽能電廠成本，並推升消費電子產品與汽車售價。
太陽能板製造商 Heliene 執行長 Martin Pochtaruk 表示，如果成本升得太高，部分能源專案可能被迫取消。他並形容，太陽能產業在這項以晶片安全為主的貿易調查中，恐怕成為「附帶損害」。
paras_en: The Trump administration is preparing to set a floor price and impose tariffs on imports of polysilicon and related products, a key material for solar panels and semiconductors, as part of its strategy to counter China's dominance in the AI and energy sectors. The decision is expected to be announced later this month.

According to a Reuters report on Tuesday, citing four sources familiar with the matter, the Trump administration is considering a hybrid system that combines a floor price with tariffs to protect Hemlock Semiconductor and Wacker Chemie's polysilicon plants in the US, and to curb China's expanding influence in the chip supply chain.

Two of the sources said the plan may allow importers who invest in US silicon wafer and solar cell production capacity to offset some of the costs of the trade protection measures. Currently, China accounts for around 80% of global solar manufacturing capacity, and the US hopes to bring more supply chain links back home through this policy.

Polysilicon is a high-purity silicon material that is used in the production of semiconductors and solar panels. Manufacturers first process polysilicon into silicon wafers, which are then made into solar cells and assembled into solar panels. The production of semiconductors also requires high-purity polysilicon.

According to data from the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA), the chip industry accounts for only around 2.4% of global polysilicon demand. However, the large volume of polysilicon used in the solar industry helps manufacturers maintain their scale and production capacity, which in turn supports the supply of materials needed for chip production.

Rhone Resch, the CEO of Toyo, which operates a solar panel factory near Houston, said the Trump administration is realizing that developing domestic semiconductor manufacturing 'actually really needs solar'. Toyo plans to invest $357 million to build a solar cell factory nearby.

The US Commerce Department has been investigating whether polysilicon imports pose a threat to national security for over a year, and Trump is expected to take action under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. This provision authorizes the president to restrict imports that are deemed to threaten national security, which Trump has used to impose tariffs on steel, cars, and semiconductors.

The Chinese embassy in the US criticized the investigation and urged the US to stop the Section 232 tariffs and address concerns through equal dialogue. The White House said it would not comment before Trump makes a decision, and the Commerce Department did not respond to inquiries.

Protecting domestic production capacity may drive up energy and tech costs. After the US Congress introduced tax incentives in 2022, the domestic solar manufacturing industry expanded rapidly, but most investments have focused on the final stage of panel assembly, with silicon wafers and solar cells still heavily reliant on imports due to the longer investment and construction time required for upstream factories.

Companies such as Toyo, Qcells, Corning (GLW-US), Canadian Solar (CSIQ-US), and T1 Energy (TE-US) have announced or started investing in upstream production capacity to meet the US manufacturing requirements for federal clean energy subsidies.

However, the US solar manufacturing association and bipartisan lawmakers have warned that before domestic polysilicon, silicon wafer, and solar cell production capacity is sufficient to meet market demand, non-Chinese suppliers such as South Korea's OCI Holdings and Wacker Chemie, which has facilities in Malaysia and Germany, will still be needed.

Hemlock, a joint venture between Corning and Japan's Shin-Etsu, has a factory in Michigan, while Wacker Chemie operates a production base in Tennessee. Wacker emphasized that without polysilicon, it is impossible to develop downstream silicon wafer, chip, and solar cell production.

The Trump administration must balance the need to support domestic production with the need to control costs. The current data center construction boom is driving up demand for chips and power, and solar developers and semiconductor buyers have warned that tariffs could increase the cost of solar farms and drive up the prices of consumer electronics and cars.

Martin Pochtaruk, the CEO of solar panel manufacturer Heliene, said that if costs rise too high, some energy projects may be forced to cancel. He described the solar industry as potential 'collateral damage' in the chip-focused trade investigation.

items.title: 川普施壓國防供應鏈去中化！洛克希德馬丁轉向美加採購關鍵礦物
items.title_en: Trump Pushes Defense Supply Chain De‑China; Lockheed Martin Shifts to US‑Canada Procurement of Critical Minerals
paras: 全球最大國防承包商洛克希德馬丁 (Lockheed Martin)(LMT-US) 正與美國及加拿大礦商洽談採購兩種關鍵礦物，試圖在美國總統川普要求降低對中國依賴之際，替 F-35 戰機、愛國者攔截飛彈及其他武器建立更安全的供應鏈。
《路透》周二 (4 日) 援引兩名知情人士消息報導，洛克希德馬丁正與 NioCorp Developments 協商採購鈧，並分別與泰克資源 (Teck Resources) 及 5N Plus 洽談鍺供應。這兩種礦物廣泛應用於飛機零組件、紅外線感測器及其他軍事設備。
若協議完成，將成為美國建立本土關鍵礦物供應鏈的重要一步。然而，中國供應商長期享有價格優勢，美國採礦與加工能力又相當有限，價格及合約年限目前仍是談判障礙。
川普上月簽署行政命令，收緊國防承包商取得豁免的條件。過去，業者可透過豁免從中國及其他受限制的外國供應商購買礦物；新規則上路後，洛克希德馬丁等國防企業面臨更大壓力，必須以長期採購協議支持美國礦場。

NioCorp 擬供應全球四分之一鈧需求

知情人士透露，總部位於科羅拉多州的 NioCorp 已與洛克希德馬丁簽署初步協議，計畫每年供應 15 公噸鈧，但雙方仍須敲定正式合約。
鈧是 17 種稀土元素之一，可用於製造質量輕、耐腐蝕的合金，適合應用於軍用飛機。相關金屬將由 NioCorp 位於內布拉斯加州的礦場供應，該礦預計 2028 年前投產，年產能約 100 公噸。
美國地質調查局 (USGS) 估計，目前全球鈧需求約為每年 60 公噸且持續增加。因此，洛克希德馬丁洽購的 15 公噸，相當於全球需求約四分之一，規模相當可觀。
NioCorp 執行長 Mark Smith 表示，兩家公司都了解鈧對美國未來國防科技的重要性。洛克希德馬丁則表示，肯定 NioCorp 為建立美國國內鈧供應來源所做的努力。雙方先前已透過五角大廈資助的研究計畫建立合作關係。
美國自 1969 年以來便未再開採鈧。目前力拓集團 (Rio Tinto) 是北美唯一的鈧生產商，年產能僅約 9 公噸，凸顯美國重建供應鏈仍處於起步階段。

鍺供應鎖定加拿大 價格仍是談判難題

洛克希德馬丁也正與泰克資源洽談採購鍺。這種金屬可用於製造紅外線感測器及其他軍事設備，美國目前超過一半的鍺需求仰賴進口。
泰克資源在阿拉斯加 Red Dog 礦場開採並生產鋅與鍺精礦，之後運往加拿大卑詩省冶煉，再將兩種金屬分離。公司並未單獨公布鍺產量，但自稱是北美最大、全球第四大鍺生產商。美國地質調查局估計，全球鍺年需求約 60 公噸且持續增加。
此外，洛克希德馬丁也與魁北克公司 5N Plus 洽談鍺供應。5N Plus 今年稍早取得五角大廈資金，計畫在猶他州利用回收原料加工鍺。知情人士表示，相關談判已持續超過一年，洛克希德馬丁最在意的是長期供應安全，希望確認原料究竟來自中國或其他地區。
不過，洛克希德馬丁與泰克資源、5N Plus 在價格與合約期限方面仍有分歧。泰克資源拒絕評論特定商業協議，但表示已同意與加拿大政府合作，擴大卑詩省的鍺加工能力。
中國礦物價格多年來一直低於西方產品，反映採礦方式、監管標準及成本結構差異。即使美國已有數十個關鍵礦物專案正在開發，採礦與加工能力仍遠遠落後中國。川普政府要求國防供應鏈去中化，最終能否落實，將取決於西方國家能否承受更高成本，並建立具規模的本土產能。
paras_en: Lockheed Martin (LMT-US), the world’s largest defense contractor, is in talks with U.S. and Canadian miners to purchase two critical minerals, aiming to build a safer supply chain for F‑35 fighters, Patriot interceptors and other weapons as President Trump demands reduced reliance on China.

Reuters reported on Tuesday (the 4th) that Lockheed Martin is negotiating with NioCorp Developments to buy niobium and is in separate talks with Teck Resources and 5N Plus for germanium supplies. Both minerals are widely used in aircraft components, infrared sensors and other military equipment.

If finalized, the deals would mark a significant step toward a domestic U.S. supply chain for critical minerals. However, Chinese suppliers have long enjoyed price advantages, and U.S. mining and processing capacity is limited, making price and contract length sticking points in the negotiations.

Last month Trump signed an executive order tightening the conditions under which defense contractors can obtain exemptions. Previously, firms could purchase minerals from China and other restricted foreign sources under exemptions; the new rules increase pressure on defense firms like Lockheed Martin to back U.S. mines with long‑term purchase agreements.
NioCorp plans to supply a quarter of global niobium demand

Sources said Colorado‑based NioCorp has signed a preliminary agreement with Lockheed Martin to supply 15 metric tons of niobium per year, though a formal contract is still pending. Niobium, one of the 17 rare‑earth elements, is used to make lightweight, corrosion‑resistant alloys suitable for military aircraft. The metal would come from NioCorp’s Nebraska mine, slated to start production before 2028 with an annual capacity of about 100 tons.

The U.S. Geological Survey estimates global niobium demand at roughly 60 tons per year and rising. Lockheed Martin’s 15‑ton request therefore represents about one‑quarter of worldwide demand, a sizable volume.

NioCorp CEO Mark Smith said both companies understand niobium’s importance to future U.S. defense technology. Lockheed Martin praised NioCorp’s efforts to establish a domestic niobium source. The two firms previously collaborated on a Pentagon‑funded research project.

The U.S. has not mined niobium since 1969. Currently Rio Tinto is the only North American niobium producer, with an annual output of about 9 tons, underscoring how early the U.S. is in rebuilding the supply chain.
Germanium sourcing locked to Canada, price remains a negotiation hurdle
Lockheed Martin is also negotiating with Teck Resources for germanium, a metal used in infrared sensors and other military gear; more than half of U.S. germanium demand is currently imported.

Teck extracts zinc and germanium concentrate at its Red Dog mine in Alaska, ships the material to British Columbia for smelting, and then separates the two metals. The company does not disclose germanium output separately but claims to be North America’s largest and the world’s fourth‑largest germanium producer. The USGS estimates global germanium demand at about 60 tons per year and growing.

Lockheed Martin is additionally in talks with Quebec‑based 5N Plus for germanium. 5N Plus received Pentagon funding earlier this year to process germanium from recycled feedstock in Utah. Sources say negotiations have been ongoing for over a year, with Lockheed Martin most concerned about long‑term supply security and confirming whether the raw material originates from China or elsewhere.

However, Lockheed Martin, Teck and 5N Plus still disagree on price and contract length. Teck declined to comment on specific deals but said it has agreed to work with the Canadian government to expand British Columbia’s germanium processing capacity.

Chinese mineral prices have been lower than Western products for years, reflecting differences in mining methods, regulatory standards and cost structures. Even though the U.S. has dozens of critical‑mineral projects under development, its mining and processing capacity lags far behind China. Whether the Trump administration’s push to de‑China the defense supply chain can be realized will depend on whether Western nations can absorb higher costs and build sizable domestic capacity.

items.title: 年輕人瘋保健品！寶僑砸38億美元買下Thorne 搶攻健康商機
items.title_en: Young People Go Crazy for Health Supplements! P&G Spends $3.8 Billion to Acquire Thorne and Seize Health Business Opportunities
paras: 寶僑 (PG-US) 將斥資 38 億美元收購營養補充品品牌 Thorne，藉此擴大健康與保健事業版圖，並吸引重視健康、偏好高階品牌的年輕消費者。消息帶動寶僑股價周二 (4 日) 一度上漲 1.2%。
寶僑執行長 Shailesh Jejurikar 接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk on the Street」訪問時證實這項交易，表示 Thorne 營運良好、歷史悠久，公司對這項資產感到相當滿意。寶僑此前與英國消費保健公司 Haleon 及聯合利華競逐 Thorne，如今可望贏得收購戰。
Thorne 成立於 1984 年，產品涵蓋肌酸、孕婦維他命及其他具有科學研究支持的營養補充品。公司 2021 年底上市時估值約 5.25 億美元，2023 年由精品集團 LVMH 支持的私募股權公司 L Catterton 以 6.8 億美元收購並私有化。如今寶僑提出 38 億美元價格，相當於不到三年身價增至逾 5 倍。
Thorne 2025 年營收已突破 5 億美元，2026 年銷售額預估可達 6.5 億美元。執行長 Colin Watts 先前表示，Thorne 未來數年有潛力成為年營收 10 億美元的品牌。目前多數營收來自 40 歲以下消費者，直接面向消費者 (DTC) 的銷售也快速成長。
寶僑旗下已有 Metamucil、Align Probiotic 及 New Chapter 等補充品品牌，與 Oral-B 及 Vicks 一同納入健康照護事業。Thorne 雖然只占寶僑整體產品組合的一小部分，但可協助公司提升高階健康品牌比重，改善核心業務成長停滯的問題。
寶僑最近一季銷量持平，營收表現低於預期，其中健康照護事業更是以銷量計算表現最差的部門。Emarketer 分析師 Rachel Wolff 表示，消費者減少購買清潔劑與尿布等必需品，卻願意增加對營養補充品等健康產品的支出，收購案清楚反映當前需求最強勁的領域。
Grand View Research 估計，全球營養補充品市場去年規模約 2100 億美元，預計 2033 年將突破 4300 億美元。面對核心消費品成長放緩，寶僑、聯合利華 (UL-US) 等大型消費品公司正透過收購，搶進快速擴張的健康與保健市場。
paras_en: Procter & Gamble (PG-US) will spend $3.8 billion to acquire the nutrition supplement brand Thorne, expanding its health and wellness business and attracting young consumers who value health and prefer high-end brands. The news drove P&G's stock price up 1.2% on Tuesday.

P&G CEO Shailesh Jejurikar confirmed the deal in an interview with CNBC's 'Squawk on the Street', stating that Thorne has a good track record and a long history, and the company is very satisfied with this asset. P&G had previously competed with Haleon and Unilever for Thorne, and is now expected to win the acquisition battle.

Thorne, founded in 1984, offers products such as creatine, prenatal vitamins, and other nutrition supplements backed by scientific research. The company was valued at around $525 million when it went public in 2021, and was acquired by L Catterton, a private equity firm backed by LVMH, for $680 million in 2023. P&G's offer of $3.8 billion is equivalent to a more than five-fold increase in value in less than three years.

Thorne's revenue has already exceeded $500 million in 2025, and sales are expected to reach $650 million in 2026. CEO Colin Watts has said that Thorne has the potential to become a $1 billion brand in the next few years. Currently, most of its revenue comes from consumers under the age of 40, and direct-to-consumer sales are growing rapidly.

P&G already has supplement brands such as Metamucil, Align Probiotic, and New Chapter, which are part of its healthcare business along with Oral-B and Vicks. Although Thorne is only a small part of P&G's overall product portfolio, it can help the company increase its high-end health brand offerings and improve the stagnant growth of its core business.

P&G's recent quarterly sales were flat, and revenue was lower than expected, with the healthcare business being the worst-performing sector in terms of sales volume. According to Emarketer analyst Rachel Wolff, consumers are reducing their spending on essential products such as cleaning products and diapers, but are willing to increase their spending on health products such as nutrition supplements, reflecting the current strong demand for health and wellness products.

Grand View Research estimates that the global nutrition supplement market was valued at around $210 billion last year and is expected to exceed $430 billion by 2033. In the face of slowing growth in core consumer products, large consumer goods companies such as P&G and Unilever (UL-US) are acquiring companies to enter the rapidly expanding health and wellness market.

items.title: 美國6月貿易逆差縮至733億美元 進口今年首度下滑
items.title_en: US June Trade Deficit Narrows to $73 Billion as Imports Fall for First Time This Year
paras: 美國 6 月貿易逆差因進口降幅大於出口而縮小，但經濟學家認為，隨著企業持續投入人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施並高度依賴海外設備，逆差收窄趨勢可能難以延續，未來幾季淨出口仍可能拖累經濟成長。
美國商務部周二 (4 日) 公布，6 月商品與服務貿易逆差較 5 月縮小 5.6% 至 733 億美元，略高於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的 730 億美元。進口下降 1.8% 至 3880 億美元，為今年初以來首度下滑；出口則減少 0.9% 至 3147 億美元。
經通膨調整後，6 月實質商品貿易逆差縮小 5.3% 至 945 億美元。美國政府上周估計，貿易逆差使第二季國內生產毛額 (GDP) 成長率減少整整 1 個百分點；美國經濟第二季折合年率成長 1.5%。

AI 設備進口暫歇 但今年累計仍大增

6 月商品進口下降 2.5% 至 3090 億美元，其中資本財進口減少 21 億美元，主要受到電腦進口大減 30 億美元拖累。包含電腦、周邊設備及半導體的資本財進口，為去年 9 月以來首度下滑，顯示第二季末企業對 AI 相關設備的需求稍微降溫。
不過，今年以來美國電腦進口額仍較 2025 年同期大增 954 億美元，反映企業積極擴建資料中心及 AI 基礎設施，對海外科技產品需求依然強勁。6 月電信設備進口也增加 11 億美元。
消費品進口減少 21 億美元，其中藥品製劑下降 19 億美元；經通膨調整後的石油進口量則降至 2020 年 4 月以來最低。
《彭博》經濟學家 Troy Durie 表示，6 月名目進口下降，顯示第二季末美國內需成長略為放緩，資本財與 AI 相關產品尤其明顯。但美國消費者及企業擴大 AI 基建支出，仍推動國內需求創 2023 年第一季以來最快增幅。
BMO Capital Markets 資深經濟學家 Priscilla Thiagamoorthy 指出，6 月逆差縮小主要是進口轉弱所致，雖然數據令人歡迎，但預料未來幾季淨出口仍將拖累 GDP 成長。

能源出口銳減 對多國逆差擴大

6 月商品出口下降 1.9% 至 2069 億美元，工業用品與材料出口減少 33 億美元，主要受到石油產品拖累。原油出口額下降 57 億美元，平均出口價格由 5 月每桶 107.82 美元降至 95.82 美元；燃料油出口也減少 16 億美元。
資本財出口減少 6 億美元，其中電腦出口下降 11 億美元。非貨幣黃金出口則逆勢增加 34 億美元，延續該項目自去年初以來的劇烈波動。
服務出口增加 11 億美元至 1078 億美元，受到金融及貿易服務帶動。隨著世界盃開打，外國旅客在美國的支出連續第二個月增加，旅遊服務出口成長 2.4%，升至 2025 年初以來最高。服務進口則增加 6 億美元至 790 億美元，反映智慧財產權使用費、運輸及保險支出上升。
以國家來看，美國對中國商品貿易逆差由 5 月的 145 億美元擴大至 153 億美元，對墨西哥、越南及南韓的逆差更創下歷史新高。美國對加拿大、德國、印度、馬來西亞、日本、愛爾蘭、義大利、法國及以色列也持續出現商品貿易逆差。
儘管川普政府積極加徵進口關稅，貿易逆差仍未明顯消失。隨著關稅政策持續變動、中東戰爭干擾供應鏈，以及 AI 投資推升進口需求，美國貿易數據未來仍可能維持大幅波動。
paras_en: The US trade deficit narrowed in June due to a larger decline in imports than exports, but economists believe that the trend may be difficult to sustain as companies continue to invest in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure and rely heavily on foreign equipment.

The Commerce Department reported on Tuesday that the June goods and services trade deficit fell 5.6% to $73 billion, slightly above the $73 billion forecast by economists surveyed by Reuters. Imports fell 1.8% to $38.8 billion, marking the first decline this year, while exports decreased 0.9% to $31.47 billion.

After adjusting for inflation, the June real goods trade deficit narrowed 5.3% to $94.5 billion. The US government estimated last week that the trade deficit reduced the second-quarter GDP growth rate by a full percentage point, with the US economy growing at an annual rate of 1.5% in the second quarter.

AI equipment imports slowed in June, but the year-to-date total is still up significantly. June goods imports fell 2.5% to $30.9 billion, with capital goods imports decreasing $2.1 billion, mainly due to a $3 billion decline in computer imports. Capital goods imports, including computers, peripherals, and semiconductors, fell for the first time since September last year, indicating a slight cooling of demand for AI-related equipment in the second quarter.

However, US computer imports are still up $9.54 billion compared to the same period last year, reflecting companies' aggressive expansion of data centers and AI infrastructure, and strong demand for foreign technology products. June telecommunications equipment imports also increased by $1.1 billion.
Consumer goods imports fell $2.1 billion, with pharmaceuticals decreasing $1.9 billion; after adjusting for inflation, oil imports fell to their lowest level since April 2020.

Troy Durie, an economist at Bloomberg, said that the nominal decline in imports in June showed that US domestic demand growth slowed slightly in the second quarter, particularly for capital goods and AI-related products. However, US consumers and businesses expanded their AI infrastructure spending, driving domestic demand growth to its fastest pace since the first quarter of 2023.

Priscilla Thiagamoorthy, a senior economist at BMO Capital Markets, noted that the June deficit narrowing was mainly due to a decline in imports, although the data was welcome, she expected net exports to continue to drag on GDP growth in the coming quarters.

Energy exports plummeted, exacerbating deficits for several countries. June goods exports fell 1.9% to $20.69 billion, with industrial supplies and materials exports decreasing $3.3 billion, mainly due to a decline in oil products. Crude oil exports fell $5.7 billion, with the average export price dropping from $107.82 per barrel in May to $95.82 per barrel; fuel oil exports also decreased by $1.6 billion.

Capital goods exports fell $600 million, with computer exports decreasing $1.1 billion. Non-monetary gold exports, however, increased $3.4 billion, continuing the sharp fluctuations in this category since the beginning of last year.

Service exports increased $1.1 billion to $10.78 billion, driven by financial and trade services. With the World Cup underway, foreign tourists' spending in the US continued to rise, with tourism services exports growing 2.4% and reaching a high since January 2025.
Service imports increased $600 million to $7.9 billion, reflecting increased spending on intellectual property rights, transportation, and insurance.

By country, the US trade deficit with China widened to $15.3 billion in June from $14.5 billion in May, and set new records for deficits with Mexico, Vietnam, and South Korea. The US also maintained trade deficits with Canada, Germany, India, Malaysia, Japan, Ireland, Italy, France, and Israel.

Despite the Trump administration's efforts to impose tariffs on imports, the trade deficit has not significantly decreased. With tariffs policies continuing to change, the Middle East conflict disrupting supply chains, and AI investment driving up import demand, US trade data is likely to remain highly volatile in the future.

items.title: 舊經濟股估值超車科技股！高盛：五大巨頭修正成美股入場券
items.title_en: Old‑Economy Stocks Outpace Tech Valuations! Goldman Sachs: Five Giants Become Ticket to US Markets
paras: 部分過去漲勢凌厲的科技股近期遭市場大幅拋售，但高盛(Goldman Sachs)認為，隨著估值回落，投資人可重新評估配置科技股的時機。
市場動能交易在今夏遭遇逆風，過去一路受到資金追捧的人工智慧(AI)概念股，在市場對前景心存疑慮後出現大幅修正。
高盛策略師Peter Oppenheimer領導的團隊指出，科技龍頭股近期遭市場重新評價，主要反映投資人擔憂企業龐大的資本支出未來能否帶來足夠回報，因此本益比明顯下修。
高盛統計，目前美國前五大市值企業的本益比僅略高於標普500指數其餘495家公司，幾乎已不再享有2017年以來一直存在的估值溢價。
Oppenheimer說：「這也與網路泡沫時期形成鮮明對比。當時估值雖然衝上更高水準，但隨後是股價崩跌帶動本益比回落，這次則是股價修正相對溫和，但企業獲利依然維持強勁。」
高盛指出，從全球來看，科技股本益比相較其他產業的溢價已由2000年初接近200%，降至目前約20%。目前科技股領漲主角已轉向硬體業，尤其是人工智慧(AI)晶片族群，在AI需求帶動下獲利快速成長。
不過高盛說：「市場仍擔心晶片產業具有景氣循環特性，且目前獲利是否具持續性，因此近期估值同樣遭到下修。」而且即使晶片股估值雖已降溫，市場對未來成長的預期仍持續上升，但整體仍遠低於網路泡沫時期的水準。

傳產估值反而升高 科技股回到20年平均

高盛也指出，近期資金輪動推升許多過去遭市場忽視的「舊經濟」產業估值。例如，工業類股(XLI)目前估值已高於過去20年區間，而科技類股(XLK)則已回到20年平均水準。
此外，必需消費品、非必需消費品及醫療保健等產業，目前估值甚至高於資訊科技及通訊服務類股。
高盛表示，雖然美股最大產業及大型權值股近期遭到市場調整，但企業獲利依然穩健，使整體美股本益比下降，而美國企業的股東權益報酬率(ROE)仍明顯優於全球其他市場。中國是唯一ROE低於歷史平均的主要市場，且整體獲利能力仍明顯偏弱。
高盛認為，估值下修反而提供投資人重新布局美股的機會，同時可適度分散不同地區配置。

高盛：動能股修正屬正常整理 輪動波動可望降溫

高盛首席美股策略師Ben Snider率領的團隊則指出，歷史經驗顯示，動能股在經歷快速上漲後，通常都會出現與近期類似的整理走勢。
高盛認為，從歷史規律以及避險基金與ETF投資人大幅去槓桿化的情況來看，市場近期的類股輪動波動，未來幾周可望逐步降溫。
Trivariate Research創辦人兼執行長Adam Parker認為，目前投資組合採取較高分散度可能更具優勢。
該機構比較自2000年以來持有25檔、50檔、75檔及100檔股票投資組合的表現後發現，即使具備選股能力，2019年以來，持股高度集中的25檔股票投資組合，不論波動度或績效，都不如持有50檔或75檔股票的投資組合穩定。
paras_en: Some tech stocks that previously surged sharply have recently been heavily sold off, but Goldman Sachs says that as valuations retreat investors can reassess the timing of allocating to tech equities.
Momentum trading faced headwinds this summer; AI‑related stocks that had been chased by capital saw a steep correction after the market grew skeptical about their outlook.

Goldman strategist Peter Oppenheimer’s team notes that leading tech stocks are being re‑rated, mainly because investors worry whether massive capital spending will generate sufficient returns, causing price‑to‑earnings multiples to fall noticeably.

Goldman’s data show that the P/E ratios of the five largest U.S. companies are only slightly above the rest of the 495 S&P 500 constituents, virtually eliminating the valuation premium that has existed since 2017.

Oppenheimer said, “This contrasts sharply with the dot‑com bubble era. Back then valuations peaked higher, then a crash drove P/E ratios down. This time the price correction is milder, yet corporate earnings remain strong.”

Globally, the premium of tech P/E ratios over other sectors has dropped from nearly 200% in early 2000 to about 20% today. The leading gainers are now hardware firms, especially AI chip makers, whose profits are soaring on AI demand.

Goldman adds, “The market still worries that the chip industry is cyclical and questions the durability of current earnings, so valuations have been trimmed again.” Even though chip valuations have cooled, growth expectations are rising, but overall they remain far below dot‑com‑era levels.
Valuations for traditional‑economy sectors have risen while tech stocks have returned to their 20‑year average.

Goldman also points out that recent fund rotation has lifted valuations of previously overlooked “old‑economy” industries. For example, industrials (XLI) now trade above their 20‑year range, while technology (XLK) is back at its 20‑year average.
Moreover, consumer staples, consumer discretionary and healthcare sectors now have valuations that even exceed those of information technology and communication services.

Goldman says that although the biggest U.S. sectors and large‑cap stocks have been corrected, corporate earnings remain solid, pulling down the overall U.S. market P/E, while U.S. companies’ return on equity (ROE) still outperforms global peers. China is the only major market with ROE below its historical average, and its overall profitability remains weak.
Goldman believes the valuation pull‑back actually creates an opportunity for investors to re‑allocate into U.S. equities and to diversify across regions.
Momentum‑stock corrections are a normal consolidation, and rotation volatility is expected to ease.
Ben Snider, Goldman’s chief U.S. equity strategist, notes that history shows momentum stocks typically enter a consolidation phase after a rapid rise, similar to recent patterns.
Goldman sees, based on historical patterns and the recent deleveraging by hedge funds and ETF investors, that sector‑rotation volatility should gradually subside over the next few weeks.
Adam Parker, founder and CEO of Trivariate Research, argues that a more diversified portfolio may now have an edge.

The firm’s analysis of portfolios holding 25, 50, 75 and 100 stocks since 2000 finds that, despite stock‑picking skill, the highly concentrated 25‑stock portfolio has been less stable in volatility and performance since 2019 than portfolios with 50 or 75 stocks.

items.title: 特斯拉中國業務成燙手山芋？與SpaceX合併恐卡在美國國安審查
items.title_en: Is Tesla's China Business a Hot Potato? A Merger with SpaceX May Face U.S. National Security Review
paras: 特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 若與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 合併，其中國業務可能成為最大障礙。特斯拉高度依賴中國市場與上海超級工廠，SpaceX 卻日益仰賴美國政府及國防合約，兩家公司結合恐引發華府嚴格的國家安全審查。
兩家市值均超過 1 兆美元的企業可能合併，近月持續引發市場討論，尤其 SpaceX 於 6 月完成規模創紀錄的 750 億美元首次公開募股 (IPO) 後，相關揣測進一步升溫。馬斯克上月在特斯拉財報電話會議中，也提到兩家公司業務重疊程度日益增加。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ) 日前報導，特斯拉高層已被告知為分拆中國業務作準備，以替潛在合併鋪路。不過，馬斯克否認相關說法，強調分拆中國業務「從未被拿出來討論」。

中國業務分拆有三條路

儘管馬斯克否認報導，分析師與投資人認為，特斯拉中國業務確實可能使合併變得複雜。SpaceX 上市文件顯示，該公司 2025 年約五分之一營收來自美國聯邦機構，一旦與擁有龐大中國業務的特斯拉結合，勢必面臨更嚴格的國安與監管審查。
晨星 (Morningstar) 分析師 Seth Goldstein 指出，特斯拉若分拆中國業務，大致有三種方案：一是分拆成立獨立公司，但由特斯拉保留多數經濟權益；二是出售業務並簽訂長期品牌授權協議；三是直接出售，買家可能是其他汽車製造商。這些方案都有助降低美中兩國對合併案的監管疑慮。
Zacks Investment Management 首席市場策略師 Brian Mulberry 表示，切割中國業務可替特斯拉在美國與 SpaceX 合併清除障礙，但也會產生新的治理難題。
上海超級工廠是特斯拉規模最大、產能最高的生產基地，也是出口歐洲、加拿大及亞太市場的重要樞紐，過去占全球交車量逾一半。中國政府過去也曾給予特斯拉優惠待遇，包括 2019 年至 2023 年的企業所得稅減免，因此對任何重組方案都握有相當大的影響力。
Mulberry 認為，獨立的特斯拉中國公司必須取得中國政府支持，北京很可能要求取得董事席次，甚至安排具官方背景的人士進入管理階層。若分拆後在香港上市，多數外國投資人或許仍可接受；但若在中國境內掛牌，持股權利與公司治理疑慮恐使部分海外股東退場。

軟體、AI 與供應鏈更難切割

從硬體與製造設施來看，特斯拉中國業務具有一定獨立性，表面上較其他地區業務容易分拆。然而，Automobility 創辦人 Bill Russo 指出，真正的難題在於如何切割共用軟體、智慧財產權、人工智慧 (AI) 系統、資料治理及供應鏈。
新成立的中國公司可以透過長期授權協議，繼續使用特斯拉品牌與技術，但這可能使全球不同市場的產品難以維持一致。加州大學洛杉磯分校安德森管理學院教授 Christopher Tang 也警告，若特斯拉持續向中國實體提供自動駕駛軟體更新等技術，可能觸犯美國科技轉移限制。
此外，雖然投資人目前主要依據馬斯克對自動駕駛與機器人業務的承諾為特斯拉估值，但核心汽車事業仍是支撐這些新業務的主要資金來源，而中國又是汽車銷售與生產不可或缺的一環。有同時投資特斯拉與 SpaceX 的投資人質疑，若失去上海工廠，特斯拉在其他地區並沒有同等規模的替代產能。
不過，Automotive Ventures 創辦人 Steve Greenfield 認為，若馬斯克最終目標是讓特斯拉加入 SpaceX，並在未來 5 至 10 年從汽車轉向人形機器人與自動駕駛，短期退出中國帶來的品牌及製造衝擊，可能不是他的首要考量。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) could see its China operations become the biggest obstacle if it merges with SpaceX (SPCX-US). Tesla is heavily dependent on the Chinese market and its Shanghai Gigafactory, while SpaceX is increasingly reliant on U.S. government and defense contracts. Combining the two could trigger strict national‑security scrutiny from Washington.

Both companies, each valued at over $1 trillion, have been the subject of market speculation about a possible merger, especially after SpaceX completed a record‑size $75 billion IPO in June. Musk also noted in last month’s Tesla earnings call that the overlap between the two businesses is growing.

The Wall Street Journal reported that senior Tesla executives have been told to prepare a spin‑off of the China business to pave the way for a potential merger. Musk denied the report, saying a China spin‑off has “never been discussed.”

Three paths for a China spin‑off

Despite Musk’s denial, analysts and investors say Tesla’s China operations could indeed complicate a merger. SpaceX’s filing shows about one‑fifth of its 2025 revenue will come from U.S. federal agencies; merging with a company that has a massive China footprint would likely invite tighter national‑security and regulatory review.

Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein outlined three broad options if Tesla were to spin off its China business: (1) create an independent company while Tesla retains a majority economic interest; (2) sell the business and sign a long‑term brand‑licensing agreement; or (3) sell outright, possibly to another automaker. All three would help ease U.S.‑China regulatory concerns over a merger.

Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry said carving out the China unit could clear a path for a U.S. merger with SpaceX, but it would also create new governance challenges.

The Shanghai Gigafactory is Tesla’s largest, highest‑capacity plant and a key export hub for Europe, Canada and the Asia‑Pacific, historically accounting for more than half of global deliveries. The Chinese government has granted Tesla tax incentives from 2019 to 2023, giving it considerable leverage over any restructuring plan.

Mulberry believes an independent Tesla China company would need Chinese government backing; Beijing would likely demand board seats and possibly place officials in senior management. Listing the spin‑off in Hong Kong might be acceptable to most foreign investors, but a domestic Chinese listing could raise ownership‑rights and governance concerns that might drive overseas shareholders away.

Software, AI and supply‑chain are harder to separate

From a hardware and manufacturing standpoint, Tesla’s China operations have some standalone elements and appear easier to carve out than other regions. However, Automobility founder Bill Russo warned that the real difficulty lies in separating shared software, intellectual property, AI systems, data governance and supply‑chain networks.

A newly formed China entity could continue using the Tesla brand and technology under a long‑term licensing deal, but that could make it harder to keep product consistency across global markets. UCLA Anderson professor Christopher Tang cautioned that continued provision of autonomous‑driving software updates to a Chinese entity could violate U.S. technology‑transfer restrictions.

Investors currently value Tesla largely on Musk’s promises around autonomous driving and robotics, yet the core automotive business remains the main cash source for those new ventures, and China is indispensable for both sales and production. Some investors who hold both Tesla and SpaceX stakes worry that losing the Shanghai plant would leave Tesla without an equivalent production capacity elsewhere.

Nevertheless, Automotive Ventures founder Steve Greenfield argues that if Musk’s ultimate goal is to merge Tesla into SpaceX and shift from cars to humanoid robots and autonomous driving over the next 5‑10 years, the short‑term brand and manufacturing impact of exiting China may not be his top priority.

items.title: 美國6月JOLTS職缺降至735.9萬個 招聘回升、裁員仍有限
items.title_en: U.S. June JOLTS Vacancies Fall to 7.359 million; Hiring Rebounds Slightly, Layoffs Remain Limited
paras: 美國 6 月職缺數量下降，但企業招聘略有回升，裁員人數仍維持低檔，顯示勞動市場持續處於「緩慢招聘、緩慢裁員」狀態，整體供需大致保持平衡。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周二 (4 日) 公布的職位空缺與勞動力流動調查 (JOLTS) 顯示，6 月底職缺數較 5 月減少 17.8 萬個，降至 735.9 萬個，低於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的 740 萬個；職缺率也由 5 月的 4.5% 降至 4.4%。
職缺減少主要來自醫療保健與社會援助產業，單月下降 14.7 萬個，休閒與餐旅、批發貿易及專業與商業服務職缺也同步下滑，運輸與倉儲業則有所增加。聯邦政府職缺升至 2024 年底以來最高水準。
企業 6 月招聘人數增加 9.6 萬人至 534.8 萬人，招聘率由 3.3% 升至 3.4%，主要受到醫療保健及營建業帶動。不過，休閒與餐旅業招聘連續第三個月下降，跌至 2025 年初以來最低，顯示世界盃帶動勞動需求的預期尚未實現。
裁員與解雇人數大致持平於 176.6 萬人，裁員率維持 1.1%，顯示即使 Visa、Uber 等企業近期宣布裁員，仍未出現廣泛削減人力的跡象。專業與商業服務、娛樂及休閒產業的裁員則有所增加。
衡量勞工自願離職意願的離職率維持 2%，反映員工轉換工作的信心沒有明顯改善。目前每名失業者約對應一個職缺，遠低於 2022 年高峰時的 2 比 1，與供需平衡的勞動市場大致一致。
部分經濟學家提醒，JOLTS 調查回覆率明顯降低，數據應審慎解讀。不過，勞動市場維持低招聘、低裁員，可能使 Fed 繼續把政策重心放在通膨。Fed 上周將利率維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%，但有 3 名決策官員主張升息 1 碼。
市場接下來將關注周五 (7 日) 公布的 7 月非農就業報告。經濟學家預估新增就業 8 萬人，高於 6 月的 5.7 萬人，失業率則可能維持在 4.2%。不過，美國消費者認為工作機會充足的比率已降至 2021 年 2 月以來最低，失業率仍存在小幅上升風險。
paras_en: U.S. job openings fell in June, but employer hiring edged up while layoffs stayed low, indicating the labor market remains in a "slow hiring, slow firing" mode with overall supply and demand roughly balanced.

The Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics released its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 4th), showing that total vacancies at the end of June were down 178,000 from May, to 7.359 million, below Reuters economists' forecast of 7.4 million; the vacancy rate also slipped from 4.5% in May to 4.4%.

The decline was driven mainly by the health care and social assistance sector, which shed 147,000 openings in the month, while leisure and hospitality, wholesale trade and professional and business services also saw drops; transportation and warehousing added jobs, and federal government vacancies rose to their highest level since the end of 2024.

Employers added 96,000 hires in June, bringing total hires to 5.348 million and raising the hiring rate from 3.3% to 3.4%, largely due to health care and construction. However, hiring in leisure and hospitality fell for the third consecutive month, hitting the lowest level since early 2025, suggesting the expected labor‑demand boost from the World Cup has not materialised.

Layoffs and discharges remained essentially unchanged at 1.766 million, with a layoff rate steady at 1.1%, indicating that despite recent announcements from firms such as Visa and Uber, there is no sign of widespread job cuts. Layoffs rose in professional and business services, entertainment and leisure sectors.

The quits rate, a measure of workers’ willingness to leave voluntarily, held at 2%, reflecting no significant improvement in confidence about changing jobs. Currently there is roughly one vacancy per unemployed worker, far below the 2‑to‑1 ratio seen at the 2022 peak and broadly consistent with a balanced labor market.

Some economists caution that the JOLTS response rate has fallen sharply, so the data should be interpreted carefully. Nonetheless, a labor market with low hiring and low layoffs could allow the Fed to keep its policy focus on inflation. The Fed left its policy rate unchanged last week at 3.5%‑3.75%, though three policymakers advocated a one‑point hike.

Markets will now look to the July non‑farm payrolls report due Friday (the 7th). Economists project an addition of 80,000 jobs, up from June’s 57,000, with the unemployment rate likely holding at 4.2%. However, the share of U.S. consumers who say job opportunities are plentiful has fallen to its lowest level since February 2021, leaving a small risk that the unemployment rate could inch higher.

items.title_en: NARLIT Approves 5 Investment Cases Worth NT$ 4.158 Billion, Focusing on 4 Semiconductor Cases
paras: 國科會今 (4) 日宣布，舉行第 34 次委員會議，會中通過 5 件投資案，其中 1 件不公開，投資總額約新台幣 41.58 億元，此外尚有 15 件增資案，合計增資 156.95 億元。其中進駐台中園區有 2 家、宜蘭及台南各有 1 家，另一家不公開，可公開的投資案都與半導體產業相關，包括浩登智能科技、亞智科技南科分公司、新台實業、丰榮智機等 4 間公開審議核准公司。
4 家公司中，丰榮智機公司設立於中科園區，本案投資金額 5,000 萬元，主要產品為半導體晶圓成品智慧包裝與晶圓傳送盒檢測設備、物流與倉儲自動化解決方案，以及半導體封裝測試製程自動化設備，專注於智慧自動化設備研發與系統整合，推出整合高精度搬運與 AI 視覺檢測的晶圓成品包裝系統。
浩登智能科技公司獲投資 2,000 萬元，進駐竹科宜蘭園區，公司產品為基於微服務架構建構的「智慧物流與製造協同作業系統」，透過軟硬解耦技術，將傳統僵化的倉儲設備轉化為具備 AI 自主決策能力的動態資源，並提供智慧倉儲管理系統、物料與設備控制系統、智慧自主決策引擎、3D 數位孿生看板、智能物流顧問與整合等服務。
國科會表示，此案以「軟體定義物流」為核心定位，優勢在於結合 IT 與 OT，對台灣半導體、PCB、精密零組件、電子製造及第三方物流具有極大應用價值。符合政府 6 大核心戰略產業的智慧製造與資訊安全等政策。
新台實業公司獲投資 1,500 萬元，設立於中科，主要產品為半導體設備硬體與製程改善優化、半導體二手設備機台翻新、次世代半導體高純度矽耗材零組件、先進原子層沉積 (ALD) 製程腔體設計製造。
國科會說，本案進駐中科，將整合國際情報與國內產學研研發能量，在園區建構具備永續減碳效益的自主技術鏈，實質強化台灣半導體高階核心供應鏈之在地化韌性。
亞智科技南科分公司，設立於南部科學園區的台南園區，國科會指出，該公司規劃於台南園區設置研發中心，聚焦次世代先進封裝設備開發，產品涵蓋玻璃通孔蝕刻設備及雙面電鍍設備，可滿足 AI、高效能運算及面板級封裝等市場需求。
國科會表示，該公司未來進駐園區後，公司將持續貼近客戶需求，深化共同研發與技術驗證，帶動半導體關鍵設備在地化與國產化，提升產業國際競爭力。
paras_en: NARLIT announced today (4th) that it has approved 5 investment cases at its 34th committee meeting, with a total investment of approximately NT$ 4.158 billion. In addition, there are 15 cases of capital increase, totaling NT$ 156.95 billion. Among them, 2 are located in Taichung Park, 1 in Yilan, and 1 in Tainan, with the remaining 1 not disclosed. All publicly disclosed investment cases are related to the semiconductor industry, including Houdeng Intelligent Technology, Asia Intelligence Technology's South Branch, New Taiwan Industry, and Fung Rong Intelligent Machinery.

Among the 4 companies, Fung Rong Intelligent Machinery is located in the Science Park of Taichung, with an investment of NT$ 50 million. The company's main products include semiconductor wafer products, intelligent packaging and transportation boxes, and logistics and warehousing automation solutions. The company focuses on the development and integration of intelligent automation equipment and systems, and has launched a high-precision transportation and AI vision inspection system for wafer products.

Houdeng Intelligent Technology has received an investment of NT$ 20 million and is located in the Yilan Science Park. The company's products include a 'smart logistics and manufacturing collaborative operation system' based on microservices architecture. Through software and hardware decoupling technology, traditional rigid storage equipment is transformed into dynamic resources with AI autonomous decision-making capabilities. The company provides smart warehouse management systems, material and equipment control systems, intelligent autonomous decision engines, 3D digital twin boards, and smart logistics consultants and integrators.

NARLIT stated that this case focuses on 'software-defined logistics' as its core positioning, with advantages in combining IT and OT, having great application value for Taiwan's semiconductor, PCB, precision components, electronic manufacturing, and third-party logistics industries. It meets the government's 6 core strategic industries, including intelligent manufacturing and information security policies.

New Taiwan Industry has received an investment of NT$ 15 million and is located in Taichung. The company's main products include semiconductor equipment hardware and process improvement optimization, refurbished semiconductor equipment, next-generation high-purity silicon components, and advanced atomic layer deposition (ALD) process chamber design and manufacturing.

NARLIT said that this case will integrate international information and domestic research and development capabilities in the park, building a self-sustaining technology chain with carbon reduction benefits. It will effectively strengthen Taiwan's semiconductor high-end core supply chain localization and resilience.

Asia Intelligence Technology's South Branch is located in the Tainan Science Park. NARLIT pointed out that the company plans to set up a research and development center in the Tainan Park, focusing on the development of next-generation advanced packaging equipment. The products cover glass through-hole etching equipment and double-sided electroplating equipment, meeting the market demand for AI, high-performance computing, and panel-level packaging.

NARLIT stated that after the company enters the park, it will continue to be close to customer needs, deepen joint research and development, and technology verification, driving the localization and domestication of semiconductor key equipment, and enhancing the industry's international competitiveness.

items.title_en: Weichun Subsidiary Lixun Unable to Repay Arbitration Compensation, Decides to Cease Operations and File for Bankruptcy
paras: 偉訓 (3032-TW) 今 (4) 日召開重訊記者會，子公司力韡因應負擔相關仲裁給付義務，經評估公司目前財務狀況及資金能力，資產已不足清償負債，現無力繼續經營，因此決議停止營業並將依法向法院聲請破產。
力韡先前銷售電動家用床產品予 Ascion，後因產品瑕疵等問題，Ascion 向美國仲裁協會國際爭議解決中心對力韡提出仲裁聲請，並於今年 2 月 17 日做出最終仲裁判斷，裁定力韡須賠償 Ascion 相關損失，後續於 4 月 10 日作出修正裁決。
為尋求法律救濟，力韡委任律師向美國密西根東區聯邦地方法院南部分院提出撤銷仲裁判斷之訴；Ascion 則提出確認仲裁判斷之訴，兩案由同一名法官合併審理，並於美國時間 7 月 23 日作出裁定，駁回力韡撤銷仲裁判斷的聲請，同時確認仲裁判斷。
依美國法院命令重新計算，截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日，力韡依最終仲裁判斷應支付 Ascion 的金額合計為 4859 萬美元，由於力韡無力清償全部債務，經公司董事會於 8 月 4 日決議停止營業，並依法向法院聲請宣告破產。
偉訓日前公告指出，力韡已於 2025 年度提列賠償金 4657.35 萬美元另於 2026 年度提列賠償金 2.54 萬美元及估列利息 146.31 萬美元，而因偉訓非仲裁判斷當事人，對於偉訓之財務及業務並無影響。
paras_en: Weichun (3032-TW) held a press conference today to announce that its subsidiary Lixun is unable to repay related arbitration compensation obligations due to insufficient assets to cover debts. As a result, the company has decided to cease operations and file for bankruptcy.

Lixun previously sold electric household beds to Ascion, but due to product defects and other issues, Ascion filed an arbitration claim against Lixun with the American Arbitration Association's International Centre for Dispute Resolution. In February 17, 2023, the arbitration tribunal rendered a final award, ordering Lixun to pay Ascion related losses. A corrected award was issued on April 10, 2023.

In an attempt to seek legal relief, Lixun appointed a lawyer to file a petition to vacate the arbitration award with the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, Southern Division. Ascion, on the other hand, filed a petition to confirm the arbitration award. The two cases were consolidated for hearing before the same judge, who rendered a decision on July 23, 2023, denying Lixun's petition to vacate the arbitration award and confirming the award.

Pursuant to the U.S. court's order, the total amount of compensation that Lixun is required to pay Ascion as of July 31, 2026, is $4,859. Due to Lixun's inability to pay all its debts, the company's board of directors decided on August 4 to cease operations and file for bankruptcy.

Weichun previously announced that Lixun had provisioned $465,735,000 in compensation in its 2025 financial statements and $254,000 in compensation in its 2026 financial statements, as well as $14,631,000 in estimated interest. As Weichun is not a party to the arbitration award, the company's financial and business operations are unaffected.

items.title: 機場服務費9/1起調漲為750元 支應機場建設2028將再調漲為1000元
items.title_en: Taiwan Airport Service Fee to Increase to NT$750 on September 1, 2026, and to NT$1,000 in 2028
paras: 交通部航政司今 (4) 日表示，考量桃園機場第三航廈及第三跑道、高雄機場新航廈、台中機場擴建及各區域門戶與離島機場建設，因應未來 20 年所需投入經費將達 6,000 億元，為利機場建設推動及觀光發展，交通部宣布將分 2 階段調整機場服務費，其中第一階段，今 (2026) 年 9 月 1 日起將調整為新台幣 750 元，第 2 階段 (202 年 9 月起) 將調整為 1,000 元。
交通部指出，目前我國向每位出境旅客收取的機場服務費自 2015 年調整為 500 元後，已超過 10 年未再調整，期間營建物價及營運成本持續增加，機場服務費已無法支應機場建設及營運需求。
交通部舉例，目前鄰近國家中，新加坡樟宜機場出境旅客費用為台比ˋ1,597 元、香港赤鱲角機場為 1,434 元、日本成田機場為 1,239 元、泰國曼谷蘇凡納布機場為 1,187 元，其他東南亞主要機場 (如馬來西亞吉隆坡、越南河內內排、緬甸仰光機場) 出境旅客費用亦高於我國，為利財務永續，實有需要調整收費以合理反映機場服務成本。

交通部說明，現行出境旅客機場服務費係由機場與觀光各分配 50%，為因應機場建設需求並兼顧觀光發展，本次將配合機場服務費之調整一併調整分配比例，第一階段機場與觀光比例將調整為 60%、40%，第二階段將調整為 65%、35%。以 2025 年出境旅客約 2,570 萬人次估計，出境旅客機場服務費調整後，每 1 年機場服務費收入可由 128 億元增加至 256 億元，機場獲分配金額將增加 66 億元，觀光獲分配金額亦將增加至 90 億元。
交通部表示，因轉機過境乘客亦有使用機場服務設施，爰將配合出境旅客機場服務費之調整，同步採 2 階段調整轉機過境設施使用費至 1,000 元，因轉機過境設施使用費收取對象以外國轉機過境旅客為主，尚不致對國人產生影響，目前我國機場連結全球 104 個國際航點，每周飛航 3,018 班次。
航政司也說明，桃園機場 2026 年上半年旅客量約 2,580 萬人次，較去年同期成長 10%，預估全年旅客量可突破 5,000 萬人次，創歷史新高，顯示航空運輸需求持續成長，機場建設及服務提升也更具迫切性。
paras_en: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced today (4th) that it will adjust the airport service fee in two stages to support airport construction and tourism development. The first stage will increase the fee to NT$750 from September 1, 2026, and the second stage will increase it to NT$1,000 from 2028.

The CAA pointed out that the current airport service fee of NT$500 per passenger, which has been in place since 2015, has been in effect for over 10 years without any adjustments. During this period, construction costs and operating expenses have continued to rise, making it difficult for the airport service fee to meet the needs of airport construction and operation.

The CAA cited examples of neighboring countries, including Singapore's Changi Airport, which charges NT$1,597 per passenger, Hong Kong's Chek Lap Kok Airport, which charges NT$1,434 per passenger, Japan's Narita Airport, which charges NT$1,239 per passenger, and Thailand's Suvarnabhumi Airport, which charges NT$1,187 per passenger. Other major airports in Southeast Asia, such as Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Malaysia, Noi Bai International Airport in Vietnam, and Yangon International Airport in Myanmar, also charge higher fees than Taiwan.

The CAA explained that the current airport service fee is divided equally between the airport and tourism industries. To meet the needs of airport construction and balance tourism development, the CAA will adjust the distribution ratio in conjunction with the adjustment of the airport service fee. In the first stage, the airport and tourism industries will receive 60% and 40% of the revenue, respectively, and in the second stage, they will receive 65% and 35%.

Based on an estimated 25.7 million international passengers in 2025, the adjusted airport service fee is expected to increase revenue by NT$128 billion to NT$256 billion per year. The airport will receive NT$66 billion more, and the tourism industry will receive NT$90 billion more.

The CAA also announced that it will adjust the transfer and transit facility usage fee to NT$1,000 in two stages, in line with the adjustment of the airport service fee. The fee is mainly collected from foreign transfer and transit passengers, and is unlikely to affect Taiwanese citizens. Taiwan's airports connect 104 international destinations and operate 3,018 flights per week.

The CAA also mentioned that Taoyuan International Airport is expected to handle 25.8 million passengers in the first half of 2026, a 10% increase from the same period last year. The airport is expected to handle over 50 million passengers this year, a new record, indicating that air transportation demand continues to grow, and airport construction and service improvement are becoming increasingly urgent.

items.title: 環球晶6至12吋全面滿載 客戶長約時間再拉長
items.title_en: GlobalWafers 6-12 inch production fully loaded, customer lead time extended
paras: 矽晶圓大廠環球晶 (6488-TW) 今 (4) 日召開法說，董事長徐秀蘭表示，隨著 AI、HPC、先進封裝等需求持續成長，6 吋、8 吋及 12 吋產能目前皆約滿載，部分先進及特殊規格晶圓供應已明顯轉緊，且客戶為確保未來 AI 晶片供應，客戶長約需求明顯升溫，應用更蔓延至邏輯及特殊晶圓產品，合約年期也比過去更長。
針對日前義大利諾瓦拉 8 吋晶圓廠火災事件，環球晶說，此次主要影響 8 吋晶圓後段製程區域，並未影響整座廠區及 12 吋生產線，已啟動全球產能調度，透過跨廠支援及委外加工方式，降低對客戶供應影響，並全面展開損害評估、復原措施及保險理賠申請作業；新的 12 吋產線初步認證進展順利，將依客戶需求逐步放量。
展望後市，徐秀蘭表示，AI 不只是短期基礎建設，且影響範圍正快速擴展至邊緣運算、智慧裝置、生成式 AI 及物理 AI 等領域，將持續推升半導體需求。隨著 AI、高效能運算及先進封裝發展，市場對高純度、高平坦度、低缺陷及特殊晶圓需求同步增加，帶動 12 吋矽晶圓、SOI 晶圓及其他高價值產品成長動能。
徐秀蘭指出，目前若不計入新增產能，環球晶各尺寸及氮化鎵 (GaN) 產能幾乎都接近滿載，碳化矽 (SiC) 產能利用率也快速拉升，下半年可望達到滿載，市場復甦已從 AI 及先進應用，擴展至更多晶圓尺寸與終端市場。
針對長約方面，環球晶表示，過去多集中在 3 年左右，最長約 5 至 8 年，但此次 AI 帶動的新週期，客戶不僅要求晶圓規格、數量及價格，更重視供應來源的國別、在地化生產及供應鏈韌性，長約模式正朝更長期、更彈性的合作關係發展。
對於價格趨勢，徐秀蘭坦言，近兩年矽晶圓市場面臨價格壓力，但近期供需逐步改善，加上能源、物流、原物料及人工成本持續上升，正積極與客戶溝通成本壓力，希望取得理解與支持。
環球晶預期，非長約矽晶圓價格下半年及明年第 1 季將持續上漲；至於長約價格，仍將依合約條款執行，但部分合約若具價格調整機制，將可進一步討論。
paras_en: GlobalWafers (6488-TW) held an investor conference call today, where Chairman Xu Xiulan stated that with the continued growth of AI, HPC, and advanced packaging demand, 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch production capacity is currently fully loaded. Some advanced and special-specification wafers have seen a significant tightening of supply, and customers are extending their lead times to ensure future AI wafer supply. Applications are expanding to logic and special wafers, and contract terms are also longer than before.

In response to the recent fire at the 8-inch wafer factory in Novara, Italy, GlobalWafers stated that the incident primarily affected the 8-inch wafer backend process area and did not impact the entire factory or 12-inch production line. The company has activated global production scheduling, utilizing cross-factory support and outsourcing to minimize supply impact on customers. A comprehensive damage assessment, recovery measures, and insurance claims process have been initiated. The new 12-inch production line has successfully completed initial certification and will be gradually ramped up to meet customer demand.

Looking ahead, Xu Xiulan stated that AI is not just a short-term infrastructure investment, and its impact is rapidly expanding to edge computing, intelligent devices, generative AI, and physical AI. This will continue to drive semiconductor demand. As AI, high-performance computing, and advanced packaging develop, market demand for high-purity, high-flatness, low-defect, and special wafers is increasing in sync, driving growth in 12-inch silicon wafers, SOI wafers, and other high-value products.

Xu Xiulan pointed out that, excluding new capacity additions, GlobalWafers' production capacity for various sizes and gallium nitride (GaN) is nearly fully loaded, and silicon carbide (SiC) utilization rates are rapidly increasing. By the second half of the year, the company expects to reach full capacity, with market recovery expanding from AI and advanced applications to more wafer sizes and end markets.

Regarding long-term contracts, GlobalWafers stated that in the past, they were typically around 3 years, with the longest being 5-8 years. However, with the AI-driven new cycle, customers are not only requesting wafer specifications, quantities, and prices but also prioritizing the country of origin, local production, and supply chain resilience. The company is shifting towards longer-term, more flexible partnerships.

Regarding price trends, Xu Xiulan acknowledged that the silicon wafer market has faced price pressure over the past two years. However, with recent improvements in supply and demand, combined with rising energy, logistics, raw material, and labor costs, the company is actively communicating with customers to address cost pressures and seek understanding and support.

GlobalWafers expects non-long-term silicon wafer prices to continue rising in the second half of the year and the first quarter of next year. As for long-term prices, they will still be executed according to contract terms, but some contracts with price adjustment mechanisms may be subject to further discussion.

items.title: 【緯創法說會AI摘要】 2026/8/4
items.title_en: Wiwynn Earnings Call AI Summary – 2026/8/4
paras:
一、緯創 (3231-TW)2026 年第二季財務與營運詳情 

財務表現： 

營收與獲利：緯創第二季營收 8954.43 億元，季增 5.81%，年增 62.43%；毛利率 5.56%，季增 0.45 個百分點，年增 1.22 個百分點；營益率 3.74%，季增 0.29 個百分點，年增 1.78 個百分點；稅後純益 148.27 億元，季增 53.95%，年增 1.28 倍，每股純益 4.72 元。

財務與營運指標： 



營業利益率 (OP Margin) 走勢：受惠於第二季 OP Margin 已較第一季改善，加上下半年起新客戶與新產品線採用更合理的商業條件 (Business Terms/Pricing Terms)，公司預期下半年及 2027 年的 OP Margin 有機會逐季 / 逐年提升。儘管新一代機櫃單價 (ASP) 大幅拉高可能帶來毛利率稀釋效應，但整體利潤率仍可維持在相當合理的水平。
商業模式調整 (Buy & Sell vs. Consignment)：因應新客戶與新專案，交易模式保持彈性，買斷制 (Buy & Sell) 或寄售制 (Consignment) 均為選項，旨在追求最佳利潤率與營運健康度。
營運資金 (Working Capital) 與負債比：因 AI 產品材料比重高加上記憶體漲價，高槓桿 (High Leverage) 成為當前產業常態。公司已通過發行 GDR(海外存託憑證，規模約 450 億台幣等值) 等多元籌資管道來優化資產負債表，管控資金壓力。

產品展望： 

1.AI 伺服器業務
下半年展望 (樂觀 / 成長)：需求強勁， AI 伺服器呈現「剛性需求」，對下半年 (含 Q3 及整個 H2) 維持正面 (positive) 展望。下半年 AI 伺服器出貨量與營收有機會比上半年進一步成長 (Half-on-Half 成長)，且預估 Component(組件) 層級將呈現「逐季向上」趨勢。
中長期展望 (2027 年)：客戶已給予的官方滾動式預測 (Rolling Forecast) 顯示，至少到 2027 年上半年狀況均非常良好；口頭溝通上對 2027 全年亦持樂觀態度。
2. 通用型伺服器業務
下半年展望相對持平。
3.PC 業務
由於上半年因記憶體漲價預期導致提前拉貨，預計下半年將面論雙位數衰退 (約 15% 左右)，但單價變高可能使營收跌幅收窄。
4. 網通交換器業務
高倍速成長：今年 Switch 業務將實現超過 10 倍的成長，主要為北美大型網通客戶設計製造並成功打入某大型 CSP 的資料中心。
產品特性與獲利：Switch 產品生命週期長，毛利率與營業利益率 (OP Margin) 均相當優異。隨規模擴大 (Scale) 及 2027 年新客戶進駐，明年預計將持續保持成長態勢。

【緯創法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】 

Q1：下半年 (Q3/H2) 與 2027 年 AI 伺服器的展望為何？ 

回答： AI 伺服器的需求屬於「剛性需求」，對第三季及整體下半年皆抱持正面 (positive) 樂觀態度。下半年出貨量與營收有機會比上半年再成長，其中組件 (component) 層級呈現逐季成長趨勢。客戶給予的官方滾動式預測顯示，至少到 2027 年上半年狀況均非常良好，口頭溝通對 2027 全年亦持樂觀看法。

Q2：記憶體 (Memory) 價格上漲與缺貨，是否會影響 AI 伺服器的出貨？ 

回答： 不會產生顯著影響。 AI 裝置具備剛性需求，且產生的效益日益顯著，即使記憶體漲價，客戶依然會購買，未看到放緩 (slowdown) 現象。相反地，記憶體漲價主要影響的是 PC 與手機等消費性產品，會延緩一般消費者的換機週期。

Q3：PC 產品下半年的展望為何？ 

回答： 上半年因市場擔心後續記憶體漲價變貴，訂單集中在上半年拉貨，表現超出預期；但下半年預計 PC 出貨量一定會衰退，幅度和上半年相比約達雙位數 (約 15% 左右)。不過因單價變高，營收跌幅可能不會如出貨量跌幅那麼顯著。

Q4：緯創在 AI 伺服器產能的全球佈局與比重如何分配？ 

回答： 主要產能依然集中在台灣 (佔最大比重)。在組件 (Component) 層級方面，台灣佔了 95%，德州新廠配合 NVIDIA 的規劃佔比約 5%；在系統 (System) 層級方面，主要亦在台灣，墨西哥廠則負責部分系統層級組裝。

Q5：緯創如何看待目前的營運資金 (Working Capital) 與高槓桿狀況？有何因應措施？ 

回答： 因 AI 產品材料成本高昂且記憶體漲價，高槓桿 (high leverage) 為目前產業常態。公司營運體質相當健康，且已通過發行 GDR(海外存託憑證) 等融資工具，搭配多元的籌資管道來優化資產負債表 (Balance Sheet)，有足夠的資源與工具來管理營運資金需求。

Q6：下半年是否有 AI 伺服器的新客戶加入？產品型態為何？ 

回答： 是的。 從下半年開始，緯創已引進新的企業級 (Enterprise) 客戶與 CSP(雲端服務供應商) 客戶，不會僅侷限於單一大型企業客戶。產品型態非常多元，包含純主機板 / 組件 (Level 10) 以及整機櫃 (Level 11) 出貨皆有涵蓋。

Q7：新一代 GB/Blackwell 系列產品對緯創的營業利益率 (OP Margin) 有何影響？ 

回答： 儘管新一代產品單價大幅提升可能影響毛利率，但緯創與新客戶談定了較合理的商業條款 (Pricing Terms)，且第二季 OP Margin 已較第一季改善。公司對下半年保持樂觀，預期利潤率能維持在合理水平，並隨著新客戶與新產品線加入而逐季 / 逐年提升。

Q8：緯創與子公司緯穎 (Wiwynn) 在 AI 伺服器市場上會不會產生競爭衝突？ 

回答： 不會。 目前 AI 市場屬於寡佔型態 (Oligopoly)，整體需求遠大於供給 (Demand > Supply)。緯創與緯穎各自擅長與聚焦的產品線 (Strength) 不同，雙方會發揮集團綜效，共同把市場的「餅做大」，並由客戶來決定最適合由哪一家提供服務。

Q9：除了 NVIDIA 之外，緯創在 AMD 與網絡交換機 (Switch) 業務的進展如何？ 

回答：AMD MI450 系列按計畫 (on schedule) 進行中，除了提供組件外，亦有接獲機櫃訂單，將隨著晶片拉貨時程出貨。Switch 方面， 今年 Switch 業務確定會實現超過 10 倍的成長 (為北美網通大廠代工並打入某大型 CSP 資料中心)，其毛利率與營業利益率皆相當優異，預計 2027 年隨規模擴大與新客戶加入會持續成長。

Q10：董事長林憲銘在最後補充了哪些關於台灣算力與產業佈局的規劃？ 

回答： 董事會已通過投資近 40 億台幣，於國立陽明交通大學校區內興建緯創專屬的算力中心。此算力中心除了供緯創集團內部使用，也會服務台灣的新創、學術界與企業界，旨在推動台灣 Open Source(開源) 動能，建立台灣在硬體製造、算力應用及模型自主性上的長期競爭力。

paras_en: 1. Wiwynn (3231‑TW) Q2 2026 Financial and Operational Details
Financial Performance:

Revenue and Profit: Wiwynn posted Q2 revenue of NT$895.443 billion, up 5.81% quarter‑over‑quarter and 62.43% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 5.56%, +0.45 percentage points QoQ and +1.22 pp YoY; operating margin was 3.74%, +0.29 pp QoQ and +1.78 pp YoY; net profit after tax was NT$14.827 billion, up 53.95% QoQ and 1.28× YoY, or NT$4.72 earnings per share.
Financial and Operational Indicators:

Operating‑margin (OP Margin) trend: Benefiting from an improved Q2 OP margin versus Q1 and from more reasonable business and pricing terms for new customers and product lines starting in the second half, the company expects the OP margin to rise quarter‑by‑quarter and year‑by‑year in H2 and 2027. Although the ASP of the next‑generation chassis lifts gross‑margin dilution risk, overall profitability should remain at a reasonable level.

Business‑model adjustment (Buy & Sell vs. Consignment): To accommodate new customers and projects, the transaction model stays flexible; both outright purchase (Buy & Sell) and consignment are options, aimed at achieving optimal profit margins and operational health.

Working capital and leverage: High material costs for AI products and rising memory prices have made high leverage a norm in the industry. The company has optimized its balance sheet and eased funding pressure by issuing GDRs (about NT$45 billion equivalent) and using other financing channels.
Product outlook:
1. AI Server Business

H2 outlook (optimistic/growth): Demand is strong and AI servers are considered "rigid demand"; the outlook for H2 (including Q3 and the full second half) remains positive. Shipments and revenue for AI servers are expected to grow further versus H1 (half‑on‑half growth), and component‑level shipments are projected to rise quarter‑by‑quarter.
Mid‑to‑long‑term outlook (2027): Official rolling forecasts from customers show very good conditions at least through H1 2027, and verbal feedback is also optimistic for the full 2027 year.
2. General‑purpose Server Business
H2 outlook is relatively flat.
3. PC Business
Because of anticipated memory price hikes, customers pulled forward orders in H1; the company expects a double‑digit decline (around 15%) in H2, but higher unit prices may narrow the revenue drop.
4. Network Switch Business

High‑speed growth: Switch business is expected to achieve more than 10× growth this year, driven by design‑manufacture for large North‑American network customers and entry into a major CSP data center.

Product characteristics and profitability: Switch products have long life cycles and deliver excellent gross and operating margins. With scale expansion and new customers in 2027, growth is expected to continue next year.
Q&A (complete list)
Q1: What is the outlook for AI servers in H2 (Q3/H2) and 2027?

Answer: AI server demand is "rigid demand" and the outlook for Q3 and the full second half is positive. Shipments and revenue are likely to grow versus H1, with component‑level shipments showing a quarter‑by‑quarter upward trend. Official rolling forecasts indicate very good conditions at least through H1 2027, and verbal communication is also optimistic for the full 2027 year.
Q2: Will rising memory prices and shortages affect AI server shipments?

Answer: No significant impact. AI devices have rigid demand and increasing benefits, so customers will continue to buy even with higher memory prices. The price rise mainly affects consumer products such as PCs and smartphones, lengthening consumer upgrade cycles.
Q3: What is the outlook for PC products in H2?

Answer: In H1, orders were pulled forward due to concerns about future memory price hikes, leading to better‑than‑expected performance. In H2, PC shipments are expected to decline by roughly double digits (about 15%). However, higher unit prices should soften the revenue decline relative to the shipment drop.
Q4: How is Wiwynn's global capacity for AI servers allocated?

Answer: The majority of capacity remains in Taiwan (the largest share). At the component level, Taiwan accounts for 95% and a new plant in Texas (aligned with NVIDIA's plan) about 5%; at the system level, most assembly is still in Taiwan, with the Mexico plant handling part of the system‑level assembly.
Q5: How does Wiwynn view its current working‑capital and high‑leverage situation, and what measures are being taken?

Answer: High leverage is common due to costly AI product materials and rising memory prices. The company’s operating health is strong; it has issued GDRs and used diversified financing channels to optimize the balance sheet and has sufficient resources to manage working‑capital needs.
Q6: Will there be new AI‑server customers in H2? What product types?

Answer: Yes. Starting in H2, Wiwynn has added new enterprise‑level and CSP customers, not limited to a single large enterprise. Product types are diverse, covering pure motherboards/components (Level 10) and full chassis (Level 11).
Q7: How will the next‑generation GB/Blackwell series affect Wiwynn’s operating margin?

Answer: Although the higher ASP of the new products could pressure gross margin, Wiwynn has negotiated reasonable pricing terms with new customers, and the Q2 OP margin already improved versus Q1. The company remains optimistic for H2, expecting profit margins to stay reasonable and improve quarter‑by‑quarter and year‑by‑year as new customers and product lines come online.
Q8: Will Wiwynn and its subsidiary Wiwynn (Wiwynn) compete with each other in the AI‑server market?

Answer: No. The AI market is an oligopoly with demand far exceeding supply. Wiwynn and its subsidiary focus on different product lines and strengths, creating group synergies to enlarge the market "pie," with customers deciding which entity best serves their needs.
Q9: Apart from NVIDIA, how is Wiwynn progressing with AMD and Switch businesses?

Answer: AMD’s MI450 series is on schedule, with component supply and chassis orders pending chip shipment timelines. For Switches, the business is confirmed to achieve over 10× growth this year (as an OEM for a major North‑American network vendor and entry into a large CSP data center); margins are excellent, and growth is expected to continue into 2027 as scale expands and new customers join.
Q10: What did Chairman Lin Hsien‑Ming add regarding Taiwan’s compute capacity and industry layout?

Answer: The board approved an investment of nearly NT$4 billion to build a Wiwynn‑dedicated compute center on the campus of National Yang‑Ming Chiao‑Tung University. The center will serve Wiwynn Group internally as well as Taiwan’s startups, academia, and enterprises, aiming to boost open‑source momentum and strengthen Taiwan’s long‑term competitiveness in hardware manufacturing, compute applications, and model autonomy.
